notes.title: Update 1.06 / 1.05
notes.content:
Hello there!

All scores have been reset with update 1.06 due to the change into how stats are now stored. If you have uploaded legitimate scores to the leaderboard already, they will still be there.

[b]WHY?[/b]
This was done to prevent/reduce hacked scores being uploaded to the leaderboard and there was no other way to achieve this without a reset.

[b]So have i lost all my achievements?[/b]
Not at all. Even though the in-game achievements page may not show the achievement unlocked, if you have unlocked the achievement on steam, you will still have the achievement. This in-game achievement page uses data that is all locally stored and retrieved and with this new update, this data has been reset. 

[b]What about my gallery unlocks?[/b]
You can move to update 1.05 at any point which has been released along with update 1.06. This can be accessed via the Beta tab. 

[i]Right click the game in your library, select properties, select the "BETAS" tab and then you can select "version1_05" from the drop down box.[/i]

Update 1.05 will allow you to keep your existing scores, so you can keep your gallery unlocks and unlock achievements based on your previous stats still. But, update 1.05 will not allow you to upload to the leaderboard. 

[b]Other changes?[/b]

*Music will now fade out, fixing the previous distortion - 1.05 / 1.06

*You can now go back to the initial menu to change between Original and Casual modes without rebooting the game. - 1.05 / 1.06

*Music will now automatically change between hack attempts. - 1.06

*Music track added. - 1.06

*Voices will no longer overlap on Game Over. - 1.06


Any problems, let me know.

notes.title: Update 1.04 - Released
notes.content:
The update that you have all been waiting for......well, maybe not ^^

It has been some months since the previous community feedback update, but after reading reviews/feedback, i decided it was time to actually respond with a new update to add new artwork to the game.

You can now gain access to her mobile phone via the Data Hacked page, you will need to get into this by finding the security pin and then meet the unlock requirements for the new content. This is for both Original/Casual modes, so it is your choice how you proceed difficulty wise. 

The UI has also had some minor adjustments along with a character BIO added into the game containing basic information, because after all this time, we need to give her a name right?

The free wallpaper pack has also been updated and well... its free, so there is that.

If you like or dislike the game, leave a review or post in the forums, it is always appreciated to hear your thoughts.

Any problems, please do let me know.

notes.title: Update 1.03 - Community Feedback - Released
notes.content:
[b]Thank you to all of you who have played Sir'Haxxx and left feedback.
[/b]
Multiple users asked if there was an easier mode, so you will now be greeted with two options on the launch of Sir'HaXXX - Original and Casual.

Casual has been designed for those of you who are interested in the artwork, wanting a more relaxing experience.

[b]Casual has the following changes over the original: [/b]
- Enemy spawn rate gradual increase has been slowed down. 
- Hack tokens will now spawn more frequently. 
- Hack token effects last longer.
- Reduced enemy damage.
- Improved cursor movement.

Casual will not unlock achievements or allow uploading to the "Best Hacker" leaderboard at the present time. You are welcome to give your thoughts on this, it is always appreciated. 	

I also noticed a review mentioning more voiced lines, so;

- Additional voiced lines and extra moaning has been added. (Original/Casual)
[i](So you will no longer have to listen to "such a bad boy" every time you restart)[/i]

[b]Any problems, please let me know. 

You can access the previous 1.02 version via the beta tab. 

Enjoy! [/b]

notes.title: Update 1.03 Beta
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.03 beta - Casual [/b]

[i]This update is based on feedback received. [/i]

You will now be greeted with two options on the launch of Sir'HaXXX - Original and Casual.

Casual is designed for players mainly interested in the artwork wanting a more relaxing experience.

[b]Casual has the following changes over the original: [/b]
- The enemy spawn rate increase over time has been slowed down. 
- Hack tokens spawn more frequently. 
- Hack token effects last longer.
- Reduced enemy damage.
- Quicker (less floaty) player movement.

*Casual will not unlock achievements or allow uploading to the "Best Hacker" Leaderboard.

Update 1.03 is still being tested and subject to change. But you can now opt into the update via the beta tab - "version1_03_beta".

Any problems, please do let me know. Feedback is always appreciated.

notes.title: Update 1.02 - Released
notes.content:
Hello there!

Update 1.02 is now out.

[b]UI Update/Audio Responses[/b] -
In-game layout tweaked to make better use of the space and a new "webcam" view has been added. The webcam view has some animation and can change upon you destroying enemies.

The audio responses upon destroying enemies are now synced with the new webcam view and will no longer instantly start at the beginning.

[i]Store screenshots have been updated to show the new layout. If you prefer the old UI, you can select the previous version 1.01 in the beta tab.[/i]

Feedback is always appreciated, i always read all comments/reviews posted.

notes.title: Update 1.01 - Released
notes.content:
Hello there!

Update 1.01 is now out.

[b]Leaderboard[/b]
You can now upload your "Best Hack" to an online leaderboard and compare your hacks to other players. This is completely optional and the leaderboard is accessible in the top right corner of the main menu.

You can now pause and quit the game by pressing escape at anytime once you have started hacking.

Feedback is always appreciated, i always read all comments/reviews posted.

notes.title: Free - HQ Wallpaper Pack
notes.content:
Thank you to those of you who have purchased Sir'HaXXX. I greatly appreciate the support. 

The free wallpaper pack is now available. Includes 4K, FHD and HD resolutions. So if you are interested in the artwork, you can download, check it out and even use it on your desktop. At the moment only 2 poses are available to use has wallpapers, to see more mature content you will need to unlock them in the game.

[i]Why is this dlc and not just included with the game?[/i]
I may add more content to this wallpaper pack in the future and i would like to keep the base game download as small as possible, so having these optional seems best. 

Let me know how you are finding Sir'HaXXX!!, whats your top score? At the moment my current Best Combo is 114 and Best Hack is 130850. 

Feedback is always appreciated, i always read all comments/reviews posted.
